entities.summary: Dmitry Nikolaevich Krutoi is a Belarusian politician serving as chief of staff to the president since 2024. He served as minister of economy from 2018 to 2019, as first deputy prime minister from 2019 to 2020, as deputy head of the Presidential Administration from 2020 to 2022, and as ambassador to Russia from 2022 to 2024.
